title: connector-openapi: path-item-level `parameters` are never read, so a required path parameter declared on the path (not the operation) is missing from the action's input schema
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, `finding` class (a) (reproducible). Found by the os-dev on #27373 (PR #27436, report comment 6490333526) and re-read by this seat. Child of #27293 (E1). ⛔ Not a claim.

`reach:` public door — declarative `provider: 'openapi'` materialization (`createOpenApiProviderFactory`, the boot path). The dev measured it at `f9a4f408` with a scratch run: an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document whose path item carries `parameters: [{ name: 'petId', in: 'path', required: true }]` materializes action `getPet` with `inputSchema: null`.

## The defect

`packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts:257-269` (read at `origin/main` 2026-10-29T07:05Z): `collectOperations` builds each operation as `{ ...operation, method, path }` from `record[method]` only; the path item's own `parameters` array is never merged in. `buildInputSchema(op)` (`:299`) reads `op.parameters`, so a parameter the OpenAPI 3.x Path Item Object declares for every operation under that path never reaches the action's input schema.

`Seam: spec: OpenAPI 3.x Path Item Object \`parameters\` → runtime: packages/connectors/connector-openapi/src/openapi-connector.ts collectOperations / buildInputSchema`

The handler still interpolates `{petId}` if a caller happens to send it, so the call can work by accident; the authored action schema an AI author or the flow designer reads omits a required input.

## Work

Merge path-item `parameters` into each operation's parameters, an operation-level entry with the same `name` + `in` overriding the path-level one (the OpenAPI 3.x rule). Tests: path-level only, operation override, and the existing control. `Metadata-protocol: none` (no author-written key changes); a `@objectstack/connector-openapi` patch changeset.

Swagger 2.0 input normalized by PR #27436's script is unaffected (the upgrader hoists path-level parameters into operations); that PR deliberately does not hoist them for 3.x input, because the fix belongs in the generator.

## Business reason

Path-level parameters are the common way vendor documents declare an id shared by GET / PATCH / DELETE on one resource. Every such action comes up with an input schema that omits its required id, so agents and flows built from the schema call it wrong.

## Reader

The triage seat grades it (`domain:server`, `connector-openapi`); the epic PM of #27293 dispatches it.

## Dedupe

Semantic search "openapi connector path item level parameters ignored action input schema missing path parameter", all states: 0 hits. The 500 most recent issues and PRs, titles grepped for `path.?item|path-level|parameters` together with `openapi|connector`: 0 hits; control `openapi` on the same set: 3 hits.
